nodes.description: Address with privileged rights; set to msg.sender in constructor and used in owner-only guards.
Privileged trade address used in ensure() whitelist check; writable via setTradeAddress.
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist that bypasses the sale condition in ensure(); set in _mints.
Mapping(address=>uint256) counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Minimum sale amount threshold configured in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount threshold configured in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum number of sales per address configured in init and enforced in condition.
Public mapping(address=>uint) token balances; mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of allowances; mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Constant decimals (18) used to scale minted and sale amounts.
Total token supply, fixed at construction time.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant UNI router address used in ensure() whitelist comparison.
Constructor: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, mints full supply and grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist/trade-condition gate: allows owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance check, ensure() gate and raw balance updates plus _onSaleNum increment.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any validation.
Internal view sale-condition checker enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale thresholds.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-influenced address with arbitrary data.
Privileged mint that sets balanceOf[spender] and whitelists spender in canSale.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale limits.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication and balance updates; emits duplicated Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress used in ensure().
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256 CREATE2 formula.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance spending and balance mutations.
a.delegatecall(b): delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, executing code in the storage context of this contract.
address(token).call(data) low-level call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn; can invoke arbitrary external token logic.
Raw unchecked arithmetic: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value, _onSaleNum[_from]++.
Raw unchecked arithmetic: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can overflow/underflow.
Parameter _to of transfer(address _to, uint _value).
Parameter _value of transfer(address _to, uint _value).
Parameter _from of transferFrom and ensure; attacker-controlled source address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom and ensure; destination address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, ensure and condition; amount transferred.
Parameter _spender of approve(address _spender, uint _value).
Parameter _value of approve(address _spender, uint _value).
Parameter a of delegate(address a, bytes b): delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate(address a, bytes b): delegatecall calldata.
Parameter spender of _mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue).
Parameter addedValue of _mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue); amount scaled by 10**decimals.
Parameter saleNum of init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken); sets _saleNum.
Parameter token of init(...); minimum sale amount scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init(...); maximum sale amount scaled into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value); recipient list.
Parameter _value of batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value); per-recipient amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(address addr); assigned to tradeAddress.
Local _UNI in ensure(): computed Uniswap pair address for this token/WETH.
Local total in batchSend(): _value * _tos.length computed without overflow protection.
Local loop counter i in batchSend() for iterating over _tos.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn: private helper validating target is a contract then performing a low-level call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender of transfer() into transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as allowance owner/consumer in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping in approve.
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner); attacker-controlled caller can only pass if owner.
_mints() is gated by msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address, callable only by that caller.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass-transferring balances.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before assigning tradeAddress.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants it the entire supply and unlimited allowance.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() derives the whitelisted pair address via pairFor().
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) against an arbitrary target and arbitrary calldata.
callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data) low-level call.
transferFrom mutates allowance, _onSaleNum and balanceOf with raw unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it without overflow checks.
Parameter a controls the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b supplies the calldata executed via delegatecall.
Parameter _to flows into transfer recipient.
Parameter _value flows into transfer amount.
Parameter _from flows into transferFrom as the debited account.
Parameter _to flows into transferFrom as the credited account.
Parameter _value flows into transferFrom amount checks and balance arithmetic.
Parameter _from is checked against whitelists inside ensure().
Parameter _to is checked against the owner whitelist inside ensure().
Parameter _value is forwarded into condition() through ensure().
Parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum in condition().
Parameter _value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
Parameter _spender keys the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter _value is written into the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter spender receives the minted balance and whitelist flag.
Parameter addedValue is scaled and assigned to balanceOf[spender].
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum.
Parameter token is scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is scaled into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos is iterated as the recipient list in batchSend.
Parameter _value is distributed to each recipient in batchSend.
Parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length in the unchecked total computation.
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Parameter addr is stored into the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
_mints whitelists spender in canSale, bypassing ensure().
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue scaled by decimals.
init writes the minimum sale threshold.
init writes the maximum sale threshold.
init writes the per-account sale count limit.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the sale count limit.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
setTradeAddress assigns the privileged tradeAddress.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance[_from][msg.sender] by _value.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked increment _onSaleNum[_from]++ in transferFrom.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value in batchSend.
Local _UNI (computed pair) is compared against _from in ensure().
Local total is compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend.
Loop counter i drives the batchSend recipient iteration.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting full privileges.
Constructor records the account that receives unlimited approval to the UNI router.
transfer indirectly consumes allowance via the forwarded transferFrom call.
pairFor result is used as a whitelisted address inside ensure().
Low-level external call to a token contract can re-enter state-mutating functions before accounting settles.
